domain state projection forma/domain-state-projection/v0alpha1
intent forma/resolved-intent/v0.11
machines 1

state User.status [entity/User/state/status]
  values: Active, Confirmed, Pending (initial), Suspended
  initializers:
    UserAccount.register --> Pending [projection/states/initializer/identity/UserAccount/operation/register]
  transitions:
    Pending -- User.activate --> Active [projection/states/transition/action/User/activate/from/Pending]
      invoked by:
        UserAccount.verify (identity-success) [identity/UserAccount/operation/verify]
  eligibility:
    Active: UserAccount.signin (authentication) [projection/states/eligibility/identity/UserAccount/operation/signin/state/Active]
    Pending: UserAccount.resend (resend) [projection/states/eligibility/identity/UserAccount/operation/resend/state/Pending]
    Pending: UserAccount.verify (verification) [projection/states/eligibility/identity/UserAccount/operation/verify/state/Pending]
